deployment: Backend before new KMP; legacy installed clients retain envelopes and query-token socket auth.

http.success: Existing message/data envelope; empty/204, raw resources and existing paginated APIs retain their own shape.
http.pagination: messages by descending integer ID; rooms by descending updated_at, UUID; room cursor signed/actor-bound/900s expiry; invalid cursor 400
http.retry: Only bounded opt-in GET/HEAD; no automated command/write replay; no implemented refresh endpoint.

websocket.authentication: Bearer header preferred; legacy token query adapter; native clients omit Origin, browsers allowlisted.
websocket.ack: success request_id after service transaction returns; ack loss is ambiguous and must not auto-replay.
websocket.event_delivery: At-most observed bounded client dedupe by event_id; events can be lost, duplicated, reordered. HTTP snapshot recovery on reconnect/foreground and every 30s while chat is active.
websocket.subscription: fetch_messages subscribes; unsubscribe_room removes; disconnect removes all; max20 rooms per connection.
websocket.limits: 64KiB command,30 burst/10 per second per connection,4000 text,10 media,50 page items. Not distributed abuse protection.
websocket.unknown: Ignore unknown fields; unknown/malformed events invalidate snapshots; unsupported commands receive unknown_action.
